lines.en: Haruka Hamasaki was a human being living on a planet called “Earth.”
This human being had large breasts and an appetite for self-destruction that, more often than not, resulted in her doing something that she would ultimately regret.

Tonight would be one more example of that- as being physically ignored by the one person in this city she could always count on to decimate her adulterous vagina didn’t exactly do much for her already debilitated self-esteem.
And it certainly didn’t help that one of her closest friends was now on a spontaneous anti-teensex tirade (that whore).
Haruka Hamasaki was a human being who loved that brand of sex despite only having like one experience with it. And she didn’t like it when people made fun of her hobbies and interests.
Well, she did actually. Degradation kink. But it’s hard to take pleasure in that sort of thing when it’s only just a recollection and you’re walking through the lobby of a hotel by yourself.
And while she could, theoretically, strip down to nothing and attempt to court one of the many plastic snowmen in the room, she would not do this. This ocean of temptation was far too vast.
There must be blood in the water somewhere — a prey ignored by great whites who had already plucked the good bits clean, leaving something for her to scavenge.
Cue Kirin Kanda — resident mola mola, still swimming around with a bite taken out of her like the fish in that one video you might have seen online. You know it, right?

Anyway, that’s what she was. I think they’re also called sunfish. But the important thing is that part of her was ripped off by something (probably not actually a great white) and taken somewhere else.
But some of her was still here, and that was really all that mattered.
At least until she ultimately succumbs to her wounds and dies or whatever, but that’s a story for another day.
: Hah...
: That’s it. I give up. What’s even the point?
: Point of what?
: The point of fucking-
: Wait, aren’t you the cafe lady? Why are you talking to me?
: I am, in fact, the cafe lady. Why are you talking to yourself, though? Isn’t that a better question?
: Because I’m mad and there was no one else around. And I will continue to be mad because tonight sucks. So just leave me alone if you don’t want to put up with that.
: I don’t mind. You can be mad, Kirin. I don’t have anything else going on.
: Why do you know my name? That’s weird.
: I’ve been involved in enough of 1-A’s get-togethers to know pretty much all of you by now. It’s not that weird.
: Well...whatever. I need advice and you’re here, so I’m going to ask. But it’s explicit, so fucking...prepare yourself or whatever.
: I work with Rin and Molly. Explicit will not faze me.
: Then, if you sent nudes to somebody and they just left you on read, what would you do?
: Probably cry.
: Right?! Like, at least say something!
: I don’t know, though. I feel like I might actually prefer being left on read instead of just blatantly rejected.
: He could at least give me some sort of excuse! Like...just say your stomach hurts or something! I don’t know!
: Is that what you’re “giving up” on then? Sensei?
: Yes...no! I don’t know! I-
: Wait. I never said it was Sensei. It’s not Sensei. He’s old. I’m young. We’re-
: I already know about what he does with you girls, Kirin. You don’t need to try and protect him here.
: Oh. Well, uhh....thanks? That’s not really the...the reaction I was expecting.
: Oh? Then, what were you expecting? Maybe I can revise my answer.
: Like...you’re too young to be putting yourself out there like that! Or...stick to boys your own age! You know. Stuff adults say when they find out about girls like me.
: Like you as in...what?
: I don’t know...sluts or whatever? Girls who just randomly send their tits to guys and expect them to come rushing over because boobs are irresistible.
: They’re pretty resistible, actually. I found that out myself when I did the same thing you did earlier and got a...similar result.
: Mhm. Yeah. Like I’m going to believe that when that’s what you’re working with.
: It’s the truth. Same guy too and everything.
: Same guy?! Well, no wonder he fucking ignored me then! He probably just laughed and turned his phone off if I had to follow those! This is all your fault!
: He turned me down too, remember? Maybe he’s just...busy tonight?
: Of course he’s busy. He’s always fucking busy. That’s what I’m giving up on — chasing him around during shit like this and then just miserably failing.
: Which is why I thought I could take a shortcut by just feeding into his sex drive and sending him nudes. But when that doesn’t work, like...what’s even left?
: It’s so hard being good and innocent and cute and stuff! I had way more success when I’d just storm into his office and show him my panties!
: Sorry, I’m confused. Are you saying that you sending him unsolicited nudes is you acting cute and innocent? Or did you give up before you sent those?
: It was just my chest. I wasn’t really doing anything...Is that not innocent?
: I think the innocent option would be to just wait around for him to come to you.
: I’d never get laid again if I used that strategy! Stop trying to push me out of the competition just because you like him too!
: I’m not trying to push you out of anything. I’m just saying that there’s too much fun to be had in life to spend half of it in pursuit of some guy who won’t ever give you his full attention.
: You’re right about that at least...
: I had way more fun before this, like...actually turned into anything. Now, it just fucking sucks all the time.
: Then just go back to how it was. Make things fun again if you’re not enjoying your life the way it is now.
: What, and just go out and fuck some random guy or something? I don’t know. I don’t-
: Or me.
: Huh?
: Huh?
: Was that...
: Sorry, are you...trying to pick me up right now?
: We both struck out with who we wanted first, didn’t we? Like, why should we have to wait around for him while he hooks up with some other girl?
: Uhhhhhhhhhhh...
: Is there a problem, Kirin?
: Sorry, I...I think I need a second.
: Normally, I’m the one who comes onto older people. Nobody’s ever really...done that first before. I don’t...think I know how to handle being on this end.
: So you’re into it then? The age difference thing.
: Well...yeah, obviously. But Sensei’s also the only person I’ve ever, like...err...at least the only person I’ve ever done anything with alone, so...
: Are you just not attracted to me then?
: What?! No! You’re hot as fuck! It’s just...well, you know...we barely know each other and...and I...
: I can keep a secret if that’s what you’re worried about. I’ve known about Sensei forever. And who’s to say I haven’t already messed around with some of your friends?
: H...Have you?...Who? Can I know?
: Do you really want to know or are you just testing whether or not I can be trusted?
: I don’t really know. This is all happening so fast. And, like...I obviously like girls. But I’ve never, like...just been with a girl if...you know what I mean?
: Then leave it to me, Kirin. I’m older. I can show you what to do.
: And hey, you might even walk away knowing a few more tricks you can impress your friends with the next time you guys team up.
: Come on...you’ve got nothing to lose and everything to gain. Plus, we’ll both get some revenge at once since your teacher decided he has better things to do than us.
: I don’t know...
: Just think of how much better you’ll feel about yourself after. I know I always do.
: I probably shouldn’t...
: Come on...you don’t even want to try? Are you scared?
: A little, yeah...
: But you’re not scared when it’s him? How come?
: He...I don’t know...
: I was at first, but...now he just...he makes me comfortable, I guess?...
: Then maybe I’m the same? Maybe you’ll only be scared for a little while?
: Maybe you’ll...grow into it?
: I guess...we can-
: Perfect. Follow me.
: W-Wait! Where are we going?!
: The bathroom should be fine, right? I don’t think we’ll need very long.
: Just enough to...make ourselves a little less sad, you know?
: Uh...uh-huh...
: But...wouldn’t it make more sense if we at least, like...used an actual room? I mean...restrooms are kind of gross and-
: It’s either that or we fool around in a room with other hot, older women. Think you’re ready for that without trying out a solo encounter first, Kirin?
: I...I don’t...
: Ooohhhhh look! Sana! Sana’s here!
: Guess we’re busted! Oh, darn! Oh well!
: Hi...Sana...
: What...are you two doing...walking around like that?...
: Since when are you...this close?...
: We’re not! Which is why this is, like...totally weird. Hahah! Anyway, have you seen Noriko? Is she calling for me? I thought I heard her calling for me.
: Ahem...Sana, this is not what it looks like.
: R-Right! Yes. We were just on our way to the vending machines! I...love soda! Every kind!
: Kirin, shh. Just let me handle it. I’m friends with her mom and-
: I was never here...and I never saw anything.
: What?! Really?! Are you sure you didn’t see anything?! Not even a little bit?!
: Nope...nothing at all...
: Have fun, Kirin...I promise not to tell Sensei either...
: Sana! Help! Please!
: Hm?...Are you...saying something?...Because I can’t really...hear you...
: Nope! Anyway, to the vending machines! Come on, Kirin! I’m starting to feel a little thirsty myself.
: Seriously?...
: Bye, guys...happy Christmalloween...
: Oh, Sana. Perfect. Hey, you haven’t seen Kirin wandering around here, have you? She sent me a text just saying “SOS” but refused to elaborate and now she won’t respond at all.
: Um...Kirin?...I can’t really remember...Maybe?...
: Who is she...dressed as this year again? All the costumes are...kind of confusing me...
: She’s Little Red Riding Hood. But I should probably keep looking if you haven’t seen her and-
: If she’s...Little Rid Riding Hood...does that make you the...big bad wolf?...
: What? No. Okay. I’m a hellhound named Loona from Helluva Boss. You should watch it if you don’t mind subtitles. You’d like it.
: Is that a...furry show?...
: No! It is not a furry show. At least...not entirely. But, just so we’re on the same page, there would be nothing wrong with it if there was.
: To each their own, Sana. You don’t see us questioning your fantasies, do you?
: It...probably wouldn’t be worth having them if...nobody ever questioned them at all...
: Stop...being weird! And I mean that in the most endearing and accepting way possible! Can you just help me look for Kirin, please? I’m worried about her.
: You are?...How come?...
: She just wouldn’t send me something like that unless she was in trouble. And it’s not like her to just disappear out of nowhere, so...
: Actually...come to think of it...I think I did see her...
: You did?! Really?! Where?!
: I think, um...she was headed toward the convenience store?...You can probably still catch her if you...go now...
: Ahhh! Thank you so much, Sana! You’re seriously the best!
: Mhm...don’t mention it...
: Heh.
